law_name: Telecommunications Amendment (Infrastructure in New Developments) Act 2021
law_name_original: Telecommunications Amendment (Infrastructure in New Developments) Act 2021
article_title: Application—sale or lease of building lots or building units
text_en:
Sections 372G and 372H of the Telecommunications Act 1997 , as amended by this Schedule, apply in relation to a real estate development project any element of which is carried out after the commencement of this item unless, before that commencement:
(a) a person who carries out, or carries out an element of, the project began to install fixed ‑ line facilities in the project area, or any of the project areas, for the project; or
(b) a person who carries out, or carries out an element of, the project entered into a contract with another person for the installation of fixed ‑ line facilities in the project area, or any of the project areas, for the project; or
(c) civil works associated with the project began to be carried out; or
(d) a person who carries out, or carries out an element of, the project entered into a contract with another person for the carrying out of civil works associated with the project.

Part 2 — Application and transitional provisions
19 Application—sale or lease of building lots or building units
Sections 372G and 372H of the Telecommunications Act 1997 , as amended by this Schedule, apply in relation to a real estate development project any element of which is carried out after the commencement of this item unless, before that commencement:
a person who carries out, or carries out an element of, the project began to install fixed ‑ line facilities in the project area, or any of the project areas, for the project; or

a person who carries out, or carries out an element of, the project entered into a contract with another person for the installation of fixed ‑ line facilities in the project area, or any of the project areas, for the project; or
civil works associated with the project began to be carried out; or

a person who carries out, or carries out an element of, the project entered into a contract with another person for the carrying out of civil works associated with the project.
20 Transitional—constitutional corporations
This item applies in relation to a real estate development project if, before the commencement of this item:
a person who carries out, or carries out an element of, the project began to install fixed ‑ line facilities in the project area, or any of the project areas, for the project; or

a person who carries out, or carries out an element of, the project entered into a contract with another person for the installation of fixed ‑ line facilities in the project area, or any of the project areas, for the project; or
civil works associated with the project began to be carried out; or

a person who carries out, or carries out an element of, the project entered into a contract with another person for the carrying out of civil works associated with the project.
Despite the amendments of sections 372G and 372H of the Telecommunications Act 1997 made by this Schedule, those sections continue to apply in relation to the real estate development project as if the amendments had not been made.
